intro: SS Jain Subodh PG College and University of Rajasthan both sit in Jaipur, and this page compares their recorded MCom fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

SS Jain Subodh PG College vs University of Rajasthan is not a single winner. SS Jain Subodh PG College is recorded as a private institute, while University of Rajasthan is public. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: SS Jain Subodh PG College vs University of Rajasthan for MCom: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose University of Rajasthan if you want a public MCom option and the admission route and fees that usually come with a government or state university campus.
Choose SS Jain Subodh PG College if a private campus, its specific specialisation or its recorded placement year fits your plan better, after you have checked the official fee notice.
SS Jain Subodh PG College lists Master of Commerce. University of Rajasthan lists Master of Commerce (Hons).
